diag.speedValue: {n} keys · typical gap {median} ms · longest {max} ms

why.slow: Too slow for a scanner — treated as typing
why.field: Ignored — the cursor was in another text box

diag.layout: Your keyboard is set to another language (e.g. Lao), so the scanner's keys came out as letters. zaokaiy converts them back to the barcode automatically.
diag.waiting: Nothing received yet. Scan a barcode now.
diag.tipNotepad: If nothing shows up here when you scan: open Notepad and scan there. If Notepad stays empty too, the scanner is not sending keys to this computer — check it is paired over Bluetooth in HID (keyboard) mode (see the setup barcodes in the scanner's manual).
diag.tipHid: On a phone or tablet the scanner works only in HID mode; SPP / serial mode needs a separate app.
diag.tipSuffix: Best setting: suffix = Enter (CR). Without a suffix the POS still adds the item after a short pause.

scan.blocked: Close the open window first, then scan again.
scan.blockedPaying: Payment in progress — finish or close the payment (Esc), then scan.

scanners.title: Barcode scanners
scanners.intro: Scanners connected to this till. Names and devices are saved on this computer.
scanners.keyboardReported: Any scanner that types like a keyboard

status.waiting: Ready · waiting for the first scan

scanners.addHidHelp: For scanners set to HID-POS mode. Shows the scanner's real name and whether it's connected. Keyboard-mode scanners (like most Bluetooth ones) already work without adding — just scan.
scanners.addSerialHelp: For scanners in USB-COM or Bluetooth SPP mode (pair it in Windows first; it appears as a COM port). Pick the speed from the scanner's manual (usually 9600).
scanners.unsupported: Adding HID-POS or serial scanners needs Chrome or Edge on a computer. Keyboard-mode scanners work in every browser, phones and tablets included.
scanners.errKeyboardMode: This scanner is in keyboard mode, which the browser doesn't let a website open. That's fine: in keyboard mode it already works — just scan. Remove this entry, or switch the scanner to HID-POS mode to see it here.
scanners.errNotFound: Not found — turn the scanner on (and pair it), then press Connect.
